description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Developments - Amendment to the Gaz. Extra Ordinary No. 2129/95 of the 28.06.2019, published on  Embilipitiya Urban Development  Area
reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the rectification of a previous legal notice regarding urban development plans. It references specific sections of the Urban Development Authority Law (No. 41 of 1978) and its amendments, making it a legal/regulatory matter concerning statutory instruments and legal corrections rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
